name: unsafe fn from_raw_parts_in (ptr : * mut T , capacity : usize , alloc : A) -> Self
rule: If ptr and capacity come from a RawVec created via alloc, ptr is guaranteed to have been allocated via alloc with the given capacity, and capacity is guaranteed not to exceed isize::MAX for sized, non-zero-sized T; for zero-sized T, capacity is ignored.
api: impl < T , A : Allocator > alloc::raw_vec::RawVec < T , A > { unsafe fn from_raw_parts_in (ptr : * mut T , capacity : usize , alloc : A) -> Self }
expression: Cannot express this requirement in the supplied DSL: RawVec origin, allocator identity, and isize::MAX are not observable.
